+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Class and example**            | **Mechanism of action**                                                                                                     | **Side effects**                                                              |
+==================================+=============================================================================================================================+===============================================================================+
| Biguanide                        | - ↓Hepatic glucose production (by glycogenolysis, gluconeogenesis)                                                          | - Diarrhoea                                                                   |
|                                  | - ↑Insulin sensitivity                                                                                                      | - Renal impairment: ↑risk if dehydrated, iodine contrast, other nephrotoxins. |
| e.g. metformin                   |                                                                                                                             | - Rare lactic acidosis (inhibit complex 1 of electron transport chain)        |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Sulfonylurea                     | - Inhibit K^+^-ATP channel → depolarisation → activate VDCC → ↑ICF Ca^2+^ → exocytosis of insulin vesicles ↑insulin release | - Risk hypoglycaemia peri-op                                                  |
|                                  | - Requires functioning pancreas                                                                                             | - Long-term “burnout”, β-cell failure, insulin dependence                     |
| e.g. gliclazide                  |                                                                                                                             |                                                                               |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Apical SGLT2 inhibitor           | - ↓Glucose reabsorption → glycosuria                                                                                        | - UTI                                                                         |
|                                  | - Limit plasma glucose to 10mM                                                                                              | - Osmotic diuresis                                                            |
| e.g. dapagliflozin               | - Weight loss                                                                                                               | - Occult DKA-like state                                                       |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| a-glucosidase inhibitor          | - ↓Glucose reabsorption                                                                                                     | - Osmotic diarrhoea, abdominal pain                                           |
|                                  | - Weight loss                                                                                                               |                                                                               |
| e.g. acarbose                    |                                                                                                                             |                                                                               |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| DPP4 inhibitor                   | - ↓Breakdown of incretins GLP-1 and GIP                                                                                     | - Minimal                                                                     |
|                                  | - Requires functioning pancreas                                                                                             | - Nausea                                                                      |
| e.g. sitagliptin                 |                                                                                                                             | - Cold-like symptoms                                                          |
|                                  |                                                                                                                             | - Photosensitivity                                                            |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Thiazolidenedione PPARγ agonists | - ↓Insulin resistance                                                                                                       | - Weight gain, oedema, hepatitis                                              |
|                                  |                                                                                                                             |                                                                               |
| e.g. rosiglitazone               |                                                                                                                             |                                                                               |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
